references.text: God hides his face because of the people's sins, the same theme that God turns away from his people
Sin separates the people from God and causes him to hide his face from them
God hides his face and hands the people over to their evil deeds
God hid his face from Israel because of their unfaithfulness
The people are described as stubborn and rebellious, corresponding to 'a twisted generation'
Jesus calls his contemporaries an unbelieving and twisted generation, a direct echo of this text
Peter urges the people to save themselves from this crooked generation
Paul exhorts believers to be blameless in the midst of a crooked and twisted generation
Earlier in Deuteronomy it is prophesied that God will hide his face when the people turn to other gods
The Lord will go away and return to his place until the people acknowledge their guilt
